lines.en: I drag my weapon across the void.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在这地方没有回声
lines.en: My steps make no echo here.
I make one circuit of the arena.
I walk slowly to the centre.
My armour clanks with every step.
I close in, step by heavy step.
I patrol this emptiness.

lines.zh: 我把武器换到另一只手
lines.en: I shift my weapon to the other hand.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方什么都没有
lines.en: Nothing remains where I walk.
I turn and scan the whole space.
I stand in the void and wait.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，也没有天
lines.en: No ground here, and no sky.
My armour is still.

lines.zh: 我在等下一个来挑战的
lines.en: I wait for the next challenger.
I breathe slowly.
The weapon sits steady in my grip.
I am used to this emptiness.
I look up, and there is nothing.
I am counting how long I can stand.
I hold still like a tower.
There is not even wind here.
I remember every opponent.
I tighten my grip slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子在这地方没处落
lines.en: My shadow has nowhere to fall.

lines.zh: 我等着，时间对我没意义
lines.en: I wait; time means nothing to me.
I plant my weapon beside me.
You came. Step into the ring.

lines.zh: 我看过太多你这样的人
lines.en: I have seen many like you.
Both your hands are shaking.
Your gear is not enough.
I will let you finish speaking.
You're counting the moment I strike.
You hold, I hold.
The void is waiting for a winner.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很轻，说明你怕
lines.en: Light steps mean fear.
I raise my head to look at you.
There is no retreat in the void.
I have waited a long time for this fight.
A dent appears in my armour.
I fall back half a pace.
That was a good strike.
I am putting that on the account.
I adjust my stance.
There is no blood to spill in the void.
I clamp my jaw.
I have not gone down.
I grip my weapon harder.
Come at me again.
There is no food here.
Give me a fight worth the name.
What are you holding that up for?
I have no use for that.
Put it away while you still can.
I carry only a weapon.

lines.zh: 这东西在虚空里烂不掉
lines.en: That will not rot in the void.
It does not interest me.
Keep it for the road.
My eyes are on your hand.
You hit my armour.
You hit my chest and bounced off.
My heels never left the ground.
My pauldron scrapes you.
You walked across my shadow.
There is no floor; keep your footing.
Your shoulder scraped past my pauldron.
Your shoulder must ache.
I step off to one side.
Do not edge any closer.
There is no such thing in the void.
I was left here to fight.
I only know opponents.
There is no need to ask.
I have no companions.

lines.zh: 这里的每一样东西都是敌人
lines.en: Everything here is an enemy.
I turn my body away.
The fight has not yet begun.
I raise my weapon.
Wrong subject.

lines.zh: 这里掉下的东西我都不认得
lines.en: I do not recognise anything that falls here.
I lift it in one hand.
Whose weapon is this?
I throw it aside.
It is too light in my hand.
I stab it into the void.
This is in my way.
I keep it; it may be useful.
I squeeze, and it is hollow.
I grind it underfoot into the void.
My opponent - step into the ring.
Come out to the middle.
My weapon is up.
Only one leaves this fight.

lines.zh: 我的标记已经在你身上
lines.en: My mark is already on you.

lines.zh: 这一战的结局已经写好
lines.en: This fight's ending is already written.
The void will remember this.
No war cry; I simply come.

lines.zh: 你的名字我不需要知道
lines.en: I do not need your name.
I close in on you, foot by foot.
This is the battlefield.
I have waited too long for this.
My armour is ringing.
I raise my weapon slowly.
You will not leave alive.
Raise your weapon.
I have taken my first step.
I have saved this for a while.
I narrow the distance step by step.
Your weapon is too short.
Get impatient, and you'll open up.
If you will not attack, I will.
Wherever you step, the circle shrinks.
There is no cover in the void.
My hand hasn't trembled once.
Your feet keep retreating.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸落进我的节拍
lines.en: Your breathing falls into my rhythm.
I am in no hurry at all.
I have seen that move before.
Your hands are too high.

lines.zh: 这里没有第二个人来救你
lines.en: No one is coming to save you.
Two steps between us.
I bring my weapon across.
If you do not act, I will.
My shadow stays on you.
Half a step more and it's the void.
This is the moment I waited for.
My feet have found their stand.
I bring my weapon down.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在虚空的边上
lines.en: That strike bites the edge of the void.
The impact forces you back.
My weapon sweeps your flank.
You did not block it at all.
I follow with another.
Three centuries went into that swing.
You fall back; I keep pressing.

lines.zh: 我的护甲挡了你的反击
lines.en: My armour takes your counter.
You will not go around me.
That one came very close.

lines.zh: 血落在虚空里，掉了下去
lines.en: Blood spills into the void and falls.
I aimed at your feet.
This ground is mine.
I pause for a moment.
My legs still carry me.
A figure has entered the void.
I step in from nowhere.
I plant my weapon beside me.
My armour announces me first.
At last, someone is here.
I take in this emptiness.
My shadow finds no place to fall.
I have waited far too long for this fight.

lines.zh: 我站定了，虚空安静下来
lines.en: I take my stance, and the void goes quiet.
The whole void is ringing.

lines.zh: 我走了一步，脚下一片黑
lines.en: One step, and blackness below.
Only a victor belongs here.

lines.zh: 我一步步走到场地中央
lines.en: I walk step by step to the middle of the arena.
I have taken my position.
This will be the battleground.
My weapon is drawn.

lines.zh: 你听见那声金属响了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that clang of metal?
I have come to stand before you.
The void has received me.
I shake the dust off my armour.
Fire heats my armour.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空里，又爬了上来
lines.en: I fall into the void and climb back.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，可我呛住了
lines.en: No water here, yet I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的护甲掀开一块
lines.en: The blast tears a plate off my armour.

lines.zh: 一发子弹打穿了我的护肩
lines.en: A round punches through my pauldron.
Magic slips through a seam in my armour.

lines.zh: 我早就不记得饿是什么
lines.en: I no longer remember hunger.

lines.zh: 雷在这片空里没有落处
lines.en: Lightning has nowhere to fall here.

lines.zh: 我本来就是虚空里的东西
lines.en: I am a thing of the void already.
